items.title: JPMorgan cuts Insulet to neutral on slowing U.S. growth, trims target by 45%
items.summary: Investing.com -- JPMorgan downgraded insulin pump maker Insulet to Neutral from Overweight, citing slowing U.S. sales growth, rising attrition among Type 2 diabetes patients and a weaker-than-expected outlook for 2027, while slashing its price target to $152 from $275.

items.title: Insulet (PODD) Is Down 21.9% After Cutting 2026 Revenue Outlook On Weaker Type 2 Retention
items.summary: In early August 2026, Insulet Corporation reported Q2 results showing US$801.7 million in sales and US$95.0 million in net income, then issued new guidance calling for total GAAP revenue growth of 17%–19% for Q3 2026 and 21%–23% for full-year 2026. At the same time, management cut full-year revenue expectations due to weaker-than-hoped retention and utilization among Type 2 diabetes users, despite strong overall Omnipod growth and higher international guidance.
